Stack of 400

A squared block of 400 printed proofs sits on a flat sky field. Its fore-edge shows one unbroken navy stripe, and the glossy Toggle ring stands upright on top under «Скидка 20% на первый месяц» and the navy CTA pill.

HERO: a real paper object. 400 printed proofs, one sheet per version of the KITE demo concept: every format and language, laid out on equal sheets with trim marks. The sheets are guillotine-trimmed and squared into one block. Every version keeps the same brand system, so the printed navy band lines up through all 400 sheets and draws one unbroken stripe across the fore-edge: brand consistency you can touch. The background is a flat sky #B4E4FA seamless field. In s3 the supplied glossy ring stands upright on top of the stack (this keyframe). It is the only 3D object and the only orange on screen. LOGO: the supplied TOGGLE wordmark SVG, navy, top-left at 108/100 in s1–s2. In s3 the supplied Toggle Concepts lockup takes the same corner, with the wordmark 32px high. Never redrawn. GRID: 108px margins. 1:1: type block top-left (headline, then the CTA pill 40px below); stack in the lower half from x390, bleeding off the right and bottom; ring centred on the top face. 4:5: the fore-edge grows taller, so the stack reads thicker; type block unchanged. 9:16: type from y300; stack y1100–1580, bleeding off both sides; bottom 340px clear. 16:9: type column left; stack fills the right 55%, bleeding off the right and bottom; bottom 140px clear. TYPE: Inter Tight 600 at 100px on 1080 (cap ≈ 73px), leading 0.96, tracking −0.035em, navy on sky, left-aligned, sentence case. CTA: Inter Tight 700, caps, 28px, +0.02em, white on a navy 999px pill (clickable = pill, per the brandbook), with a thin arrow. ACCENT: the hard-edged navy stripe. It runs through the fore-edge, and the CTA pill is that same stripe pulled out as a button. Orange appears only on the ring. CRAFT/IMAGERY: real production, not CG. Digital print on 170gsm uncoated white stock, trimmed on a guillotine, shot with a 100mm macro on a motion-control rig. Soft daylight from top-left through a large diffuser, a single soft contact shadow, a slightly cool grade with soft contrast, and no HDR. The riffle is real stop-motion at 12fps on twos. The ring is the supplied PNG, composited upright and colour-matched to the daylight. In this keyframe, a vector sketch with a line pattern stands in for that set. MOTION: calm, power4.out, no bounce. Only what changes moves. SCENES (12 s): s1 HOOK 0–3.6. Top-down macro on sheet 1, a KITE 4:5 proof. A thumb riffles the block like a flip-book: the prints flicker through formats and languages, but the layout never jumps. It stops on a sheet whose folio corner reads «400» (the approved number, as digits). «Креатив №400.» sharpens in from blur, then «Всё ещё вы.». Transition: a motion-control tilt (0.6s, expo.out) from top-down to a low 3/4 view reveals the fore-edge and its unbroken navy stripe. s2 PROOF 3.6–6.2. A hand fans the upper sheets into an arc of 9:16, 4:5, 1:1 and 16:9 proofs in RU/EN/ES. An expert's pencil ticks each corner in one pass: the check is shown, not said. One tap squares the fan back, and the stripe falls into a straight line again. «Один концепт. Все версии.» Transition: the block settles with no bounce, and the ring lowers straight down onto the top sheet, upright (power4.out), never spun or tilted. s3 OFFER + CTA 6.2–12 (this keyframe). Lockup, «Скидка 20% на первый месяц», the navy pill «НАЧАТЬ ПРОБНЫЙ МЕСЯЦ →», and the ring on the stack. Only the CTA arrow moves, nudging 6px once at 9s; then hold. 6 s CUT: s1 runs 0–3 (riffle 1.4s, stopping on 400), then a hard cut to the s3 set with the lockup and the ring on the stack. The offer line is dropped, and the CTA pill moves up into the headline slot. Founder VO captions sit on a solid white plate above the safe zone.
